question: top Avocado Oil brands companies Peru
markdown:
Peru is a major global producer of Hass avocados
, supplying bulk crude and organic avocado oil to international brands. Key local processing and exporting companies include
⁠Sutrimex Peru SAC
Virù S.A.
Westfalia Fruit Peru
, and
Biodrop SAC
. International brands like
⁠La Tourangelle
also source and craft their oils directly in Peru.
Export Genius
Top Exporters and Producers in Peru
Virù S.A.:
Major agro-industrial exporter providing bulk crude and refined avocado oil via flexitanks.
Westfalia Fruit Peru SAC:
Local branch of the global Westfalia group, specializing in industrial-grade crude avocado oil.
Sutrimex Peru SAC:
Supplier focused on organic raw and bulk avocado oils.
Biodrop SAC & Deshidratados Tropicales:
Key regional exporters handling bulk raw and crude shipments.
Eco Farms Peru:
Noted producer involved in sustainable avocado harvesting and processing lines.
Export Genius
Global Brands Sourcing from Peru
La Tourangelle:
Produces targeted specialty oils, featuring dedicated lines crafted from Peruvian Hass avocados.
